result.summary: Found 2 visual layout issues, mainly text collision in the restaurant metadata and partially clipped carousel content at the right edge.

issues.description: The metadata row under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visually broken: the time/delivery text overlaps, making it read like “25–30 min delivery” with duplicated or colliding delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the restaurant card metadata layout so each label has enough horizontal space, uses proper separators, and truncates gracefully if needed.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrollable content is partially cut off at the right edge, such as the next category chip and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” While this can indicate scrollability, the visible fragments look a bit abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent carousel padding, a fade/peek treatment, or ensure partially visible items are clipped more intentionally.
